title: T CrB: RLMT slitless-grism H-alpha spectra and equivalent widths, 2025 February-June (MACRO Consortium release)
description: Reduced 1-D slitless-grism spectra of the recurrent nova T CrB from the 0.5 m Robert L. Mutel Telescope, their H-alpha equivalent widths per frame and per night, line flux against orbital phase, the same-date ARAS cross-validation, and the archival 2024 B anchors. See README.md.
notes: Released on behalf of the MACRO Consortium. Code: pipeline/macro_tcrb, pipeline/scripts/run_tcrb.py.
